errors.dev_token_open_dir: open data dir for dev token
errors.dev_session_failed: could not start the dev session

errors.github_secret_required: OCTOPUS_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET is required when OCTOPUS_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID is set

errors.sso_session_missing: SSO session not found — start the login from this browser

errors.github_no_verified_email: no verified email on GitHub account — verify your email with GitHub first

errors.sso_email_unverified: your identity provider reports this email as unverified — verify it first
errors.sso_not_allowed: this account is not allowed to sign in to this install

errors.sso_group_not_allowed: {cause}: not a member of an allowed group

errors.sso_default_role_invalid: OCTOPUS_SSO_DEFAULT_ROLE={role:%q} is not one of viewer, developer, admin
errors.sso_newcomer_email_unverified: your identity provider has not verified this email yet: verify it there, then sign in again
errors.signup_not_invited: {cause}: sign-up here is by invitation and this email is not on the list
errors.operator_only: only the operator may do this: an admin of the workspace named by {env}
errors.signup_email_invalid: enter one email address, like ana@example.com
errors.signup_note_too_long: the note can be at most {max} characters
errors.signup_allowlist_from_env: this email comes from {env}: remove it there and restart the daemon
errors.signup_allowlist_not_found: this email is not on the list
errors.signup_mode_invalid: OCTOPUS_SIGNUP_MODE={value:%q} is not a signup mode: use open or allowlist
errors.member_role_invalid: {role:%q} is not a role: use viewer, developer, admin or owner
errors.owner_not_grantable_on_add: a workspace has one owner, so owner can't be granted by adding a member
errors.owner_membership_fixed: the workspace owner's membership can't be changed by adding them again
errors.owner_not_grantable_on_update: a workspace has one owner: to change it, transfer the workspace
errors.owner_role_fixed: the workspace owner's role can't be changed: to stop being owner, transfer the workspace
errors.dev_mode_with_oidc: OCTOPUS_DEV_MODE=1 turns sign-in off, but OCTOPUS_OIDC_ISSUER says this install has logins: unset one of them
errors.workspace_cap_reached: you already own {max} workspaces, the most one account can own here
errors.workspace_name_no_slug: the workspace name needs at least one letter or digit
errors.max_owned_workspaces_invalid: OCTOPUS_MAX_OWNED_WORKSPACES={value:%q} is not a whole number of 0 or more (0 means no cap)
errors.access_request_invalid: this access request link is not valid
errors.access_request_expired: this access request link expired: sign in again to get a new one
errors.signup_request_not_found: there is no access request for that email
errors.workspace_name_too_long: the name can have at most {max} characters
errors.owner_not_placeholder: this workspace already has an owner who signs in: they hand it over from Account → Your workspaces

labels.saas_guard_dev_mode: dev mode turns sign-in off: every visitor would be the owner
labels.saas_guard_host_llm_credential: runs without a key of their own would use the operator's LLM key, on the operator's bill
labels.saas_guard_ambient_cloud_identity: Bedrock or Vertex profiles without a credential would run as the daemon's cloud identity
labels.saas_guard_sso_autolink: a sign-in would take over an existing account by matching its email
labels.saas_guard_sso_default_workspace: every new user would join that one workspace, next to every other tenant
labels.saas_guard_secretbox_plaintext: tenant secrets could be stored unencrypted
labels.saas_guard_secretbox_key: neither it nor OCTOPUS_SECRETBOX_KEY_FILE is set, so tenant secrets would not have a key of their own
labels.saas_guard_git_local_remotes: projects could clone paths on the daemon's own disk
labels.saas_guard_git_ssh: SSH remotes run with the daemon host's SSH keys and config
labels.saas_guard_no_sso: no identity provider is configured (nor OCTOPUS_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID), so nobody could sign in
labels.saas_guard_no_operator: not set: nobody is the operator, so nobody can manage the signup allowlist or the install-wide settings from the dashboard
labels.saas_guard_signup_open: open: anyone the identity provider authenticates gets an account and a workspace
labels.saas_guard_no_personal_workspaces: off: new users get no workspace of their own and wait for an invitation
